caption: The video captures a white ceramic mug with a left handle on a light wooden surface against a dark, blurred background, partly filled with coffee. A stream of coffee is already falling from above into the right side of the mug, striking the surface and churning up foam and ripples. The stream steadily thins to a narrow trickle before vanishing, leaving only disturbed liquid and rising steam. A brief, fine trickle then reappears near the center, ending in a small bright disturbance, after which no further pouring appears. The foam band from the pour gradually settles into a small cluster of pale bubbles along the far rim. The mug remains in place and the viewpoint appears stable. Faint steam continues to drift from the dark coffee surface as the liquid calms.
